candidates.bear_case: A one-day volume spike in a defensive tape with breadth at 20.8%, whose cause this run could not identify because no issuer source was openable; price fails straight back below the EUR6.990 breakout-day low.
candidates.pre_mortem: The most likely overlooked failure: Nov 3's 3.28x volume was an event-driven spike on news this run never saw, so the 'base breakout' reading is a chart artifact on top of unknown information, and price is back under EUR7 before any retest entry triggers. Three unverifiable sessions (Nov 4-6) have already passed.
candidates.red_team_argument: The breakout is real and repository-verified, but no defensible setup reaches 1.5R. Structural stop below the EUR6.990 breakout-day low (use EUR6.95) against a EUR7.40 retest entry is EUR0.45 risk; nearest supply is the 2026-08-03..08-10 swing cluster topping at EUR7.908, giving 0.78R to a EUR7.75 first target and only 1.13R to EUR7.908. 1.5R would need a EUR8.075 target, above the August high and inside July-August supply. Tightening the stop to ~EUR7.20 manufactures 1.8R but is only ~1x the EUR0.194 ATR14 and is not invalidation. Catalyst is 31 days out, so no catalyst support inside 21 days. Defensive regime requires regime-against logging. Action is wait_pullback, not an entry.

candidates.expectations: Now well established, and this is the material addition versus the 18:07Z run, which recorded fresh consensus as unconfirmed and relied on July ARR of ~USD1.938bn. Company Q3 FY27 guidance is revenue USD440-445m and ARR USD1.992-1.997bn as of 2026-10-31. Analyst consensus Q3 revenue is approximately USD441.1-441.2m, essentially the guidance midpoint. FY27 guidance USD1.789-1.794bn against roughly USD1.78bn consensus.
candidates.priced_in: Yes, adversely for anticipation. Consensus sitting at the guidance midpoint leaves no cushion: merely meeting guidance is the expected outcome. The decisive evidence is the prior quarter's reaction - Q2 FY27 revenue of USD410.26m beat the USD397.77m expectation and the stock still fell about 9.77% after hours. A beat did not produce upside one quarter ago.
candidates.bull_case: Agentic/automation ARR re-accelerates past the USD1.997bn top end and FY28 commentary resets the growth narrative.
candidates.bear_case: Q3 lands inside guidance, ARR is unremarkable, and the stock de-rates again on FY28 commentary, repeating the Q2 pattern of selling off into a beat.
candidates.pre_mortem: The overlooked failure is treating a verified date as an edge. With consensus at the guidance midpoint and a demonstrated sell-the-beat reaction, an anticipatory long is gapped through any stop on Dec 3 regardless of where that stop sits; and price is already below its ~USD14.04 50-day average, so the trend does not support anticipation either.
candidates.red_team_argument: No setup exists and none can be computed: this repository holds no PATH price history (the snapshot carries only ARRY and GRAB) and every quote host is unreachable, so entry, stop, target and R are unavailable rather than merely unattractive. On top of that the expectations work argues actively against pre-event entry - consensus equals the guidance midpoint and the last beat produced a ~9.77% after-hours decline. The event is 25 days out, outside the 21-day actionable window, with no nearer verified trigger. Correct action is monitor; if it is ever traded it belongs after Dec 3 as a post-earnings-drift candidate.
